Figure 1: Overview of Skill-R1. Recurrent Skill Evolution iteratively generates skills, rolls out a frozen task LLM, and stores verifier-scored outcomes in an evolutionary history. Bilevel GRPO Optimization computes GRPO advantages from both intra-generation relative performance and inter-generation progress, and uses it to update the skill generator while keeping the task LLM frozen.
